interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the table, the sweep and what a check proves.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through a safe sweep and the details of a plugin.

interactive.label: Test all plugins
interactive.tooltip: Construct and draw the native window of every discovered plugin, one at a time, each in a separate process on throw-away settings.

interactive.label: Test safe plugins
interactive.tooltip: Check only the first ten plugins of the list, with a short startup timeout (5 s).

interactive.label: Stop
interactive.tooltip: Stop the sweep and terminate the plugin that is being checked right now.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Rescan the plugin folders and clear the displayed results.

interactive.label: Clear blacklist
interactive.tooltip: Take every plugin off the blacklist (a plugin that failed five checks in a row is skipped) so it is tested again.

interactive.label: delay
interactive.tooltip: Pause between two plugin checks so the machine is not overloaded; Stop stays responsive during the pause.

interactive.label: Skip blacklisted
interactive.tooltip: Do not check plugins that failed five times in a row; they show as skipped.
